name: WCCM Mexico
reason: No usable photo: wccm-mexico.org is a Wix site, so every image sits on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses our robots.txt request; the videos it embeds come from other people's channels, so there is no own channel avatar either. Content otherwise modest: contact form, a six-week introductory course, 'Hablemos de Meditación' and a Santa Teresa series (all 'multiple dates', already running), and a symposium in Mexico City.
